subject: reasoning
question: Town A is to the northwest of Town B. Town D is to the north of Town C. Town B is to the east of Town C. Town M is to the North of Town B. Town D is southeast of Town A. Town M is East of Town A. What is the position of Town D with respect to Town B?
solution:
Given: 

Town A is to the northwest of Town B.

Town D is to the north of Town C.

Town B is to the east of Town C.

Town M is to the North of Town B.

Town D is southeast of Town A.

Town M is East of Town A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/789351b75fe2a67ffffe7528f593ddc63929ea4212c6dc3f8945528674fd6702.png] 

So, Town D is Northwest of Town B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
